_comment: Optional. Copy to %APPDATA%\ASAPLabs\gc-hub-tray.json (or pass --config) and keep only what you change; every key has this default. No password goes here: the tray asks for it and keeps it in memory only.
_updater_python: Empty = the tray's own interpreter (the release .venv); updater.py is stdlib-only.
_busy: Amber when the hub uses more than cpu_busy_percent of one core for cpu_busy_seconds, or more than queue_busy_threshold jobs are due.
